# AT Automation

AT Automation is a business automation and systems integration service based in Lugano, Switzerland.

It helps companies connect existing business systems and coordinate processes across operations, finance, sales, inventory, customers and management.

Core capabilities:
- Business process automation
- ERP and CRM integration
- Finance and operations workflows
- Inventory and order automation
- API and webhook integrations
- Internal and specialized business systems
- Business rules and AI-assisted workflows

Languages:
English, German, Italian, French, Russian, Ukrainian

Main website:
https://at-automation-ai.vercel.app

Live demo:
https://at-automation-ai.vercel.app/demo
